review.reviewBody: These fries with the brisket are sooooooo amazing a must have!

They were kind, prompt and polite.  Delicious.   When ordering online keep in mind they tend to finish earlier then shown online.  Only thing is the tri tip might have a lot of bristle(fat).  Other then that I got the onion rings, mac n cheese, chicken and tri tip 3 combo for $39!  It was worth it!
Best place in town to get barbecue The brisket was on point ￼￼

mainEntity.name: What is the The Rustic Barrel's address?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Rustic Barrel is located at 611 Canal St, King City CA 93930-3503, United States. This is where you will go to get DoorDash Pickup orders, and where Dashers will go to get your DoorDash delivery orders.

mainEntity.name: Does The Rustic Barrel offer delivery or pickup?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can browse The Rustic Barrel’s menu and place an order for both Delivery and Pickup on DoorDash. The Rustic Barrel may also offer delivery and pickup on their own or through other delivery services.

mainEntity.name: What are the most popular dishes at The Rustic Barrel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The dishes most commonly ordered by DoorDash customers at The Rustic Barrel are 2 Meat Combo, OG Smash Burger - Double and Pulled Pork Sandwich.

mainEntity.name: Is The Rustic Barrel a DashPass eligible store?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Rustic Barrel offers DashPass benefits like $0 delivery, reduced service fees, and $5 credits back on Pickup orders. If you want to know if a store is DashPass eligible, you can look for the DashPass icon next to their name.
